questions.explanation: Possessif ('s) + NOM : the volunteer's dedication.
questions.prompt: The committee praised the volunteer's ___ during the crisis.

questions.explanation: Verbe + nom complément : declare insolvency (comme declare bankruptcy).
questions.prompt: Several small firms had to declare ___ after the recession.

questions.explanation: suggest / recommend / consider / avoid + -ING.
questions.prompt: The auditor suggested ___ the inventory process.

questions.explanation: It appears that → action en cours maintenant : présent continu.
questions.prompt: It appears that the merger talks ___ a final agreement.

questions.explanation: Préposition + which. Jamais « in that » ni « in where ».
questions.prompt: This is the office in ___ the contract was signed.

questions.explanation: Il faut le verbe conjugué actif : the company specializes in.
questions.prompt: Delmar Logistics ___ in cold-chain transportation.

questions.explanation: stranded = bloqué.
questions.prompt: Dozens of tourists were ___ on the island when the ferry service stopped.

questions.explanation: Possessif + NOM : Ms. Ortiz's responsiveness.
questions.prompt: Ms. Ortiz's ___ to customer feedback has improved our ratings.

questions.explanation: recommend + -ING.
questions.prompt: We recommend ___ your password every three months.

questions.explanation: It seems that + situation actuelle → présent continu.
questions.prompt: It seems that the new branch ___ well this quarter.

items.title: QCM du matin, vendredi 13 novembre
items.theme: Tes 5 règles prioritaires + nature des mots

questions.prompt: The firm's ___ to sustainability has attracted new investors.
questions.explanation: Possessif ('s) + NOM : the firm's commitment.

questions.prompt: The CEO's ___ was announced yesterday afternoon.
questions.explanation: Possessif ('s) + NOM : the CEO's resignation.

questions.prompt: Analysts expect strong ___ in the renewable energy sector.
questions.explanation: Verbe (expect) + adjectif + NOM : strong growth.

questions.prompt: The agency provides ___ to small businesses that export.
questions.explanation: Verbe (provide) + NOM complément : provides assistance.

questions.prompt: The consultant recommended ___ the meeting to Friday.
questions.explanation: recommend + -ING : recommended moving.

questions.prompt: Have you considered ___ for the manager position?
questions.explanation: consider + -ING : considered applying.

questions.prompt: It appears that sales ___ steadily this quarter.
questions.explanation: It appears that + situation en cours → présent continu : are rising.

questions.prompt: It seems that the store ___ extra staff for the holiday season.
questions.explanation: It seems that + action en cours → présent continu : is hiring.

questions.prompt: The report, in ___ the results are summarized, is attached.
questions.explanation: Préposition + WHICH (chose) : in which. Jamais « in that ».

questions.prompt: The manager to ___ you should send the invoice is Mr. Ross.
questions.explanation: Préposition + WHOM (personne) : to whom.

questions.prompt: The new software is ___ easy to install.
questions.explanation: ADVERBE devant un adjectif (easy) : remarkably easy.

questions.prompt: Ms. Tan gave a very ___ presentation on market trends.
questions.explanation: very + ADJECTIF + nom (presentation) : very informative.

questions.prompt: Please read the instructions ___ before using the device.
questions.explanation: ADVERBE pour décrire comment on fait l'action (read) : carefully.

questions.prompt: The ___ of the new branch is scheduled for May.
questions.explanation: the + NOM + of : the opening of.

questions.prompt: Our team worked ___ to meet the tight deadline.
questions.explanation: Verbe (worked) + ADVERBE : worked efficiently.

items.title: QCM de l'après-midi, vendredi 13 novembre
items.theme: Rappel des règles prioritaires + temps des verbes

questions.prompt: The manager's ___ to the proposal surprised everyone.
questions.explanation: Possessif + NOM : the manager's objection.

questions.prompt: The committee will announce its ___ next week.
questions.explanation: Possessif (its) + NOM : its decision.

questions.prompt: We suggest ___ your tickets online to avoid queues.
questions.explanation: suggest + -ING : suggest booking.

questions.prompt: It appears that the merger ___ final approval.
questions.explanation: It appears that + situation en cours → présent continu.

questions.prompt: The hotel at ___ the conference took place has 400 rooms.
questions.explanation: Préposition + WHICH : at which.

questions.prompt: The new catalogue is ___ designed and easy to read.
questions.explanation: ADVERBE devant un participe (designed) : beautifully designed.

questions.prompt: Several firms filed for ___ after the crisis.
questions.explanation: Préposition (for) + NOM : filed for bankruptcy.

questions.prompt: Ms. Park ___ for the company since 2019.
questions.explanation: since + date → present perfect : has worked.

questions.prompt: Last year, the firm ___ two new offices in Asia.
questions.explanation: Last year → prétérit (action terminée, date précise) : opened.

questions.prompt: By the end of next month, we ___ the new system.
questions.explanation: By + moment futur → futur antérieur : will have installed.

questions.prompt: The shipment ___ yet, so please wait before calling.
questions.explanation: yet → present perfect (négatif) : hasn't arrived yet.

questions.prompt: When the CEO arrived, the meeting ___ already ___.
questions.explanation: Action antérieure à une autre action passée → past perfect : had already started.

questions.prompt: The team ___ on the report right now.
questions.explanation: right now → présent continu : is working.

questions.prompt: If sales increase, we ___ more staff next year.
questions.explanation: If + présent → futur (will) : will hire.

questions.prompt: Mr. Lee usually ___ the bus to work.
questions.explanation: usually (habitude) → présent simple : takes.

items.title: Samedi matin : suggest + -ing et temps du passé

questions.prompt: The consultant suggested ------- the launch until the spring.
questions.explanation: suggest + -ING : suggest postponing. Jamais suggest to + verbe.

questions.prompt: Ms. Tanaka recommends ------- the contract carefully before signing it.
questions.explanation: recommend + -ING (recommend reviewing). Même famille : suggest, consider, avoid, mind, finish.

questions.prompt: To reduce costs, the board is considering ------- two regional offices.
questions.explanation: consider + -ING : considering merging.

questions.prompt: Customers praised the hotel's ------- during the busy holiday season.
questions.explanation: Possessif ('s) + NOM : the hotel's efficiency.

questions.prompt: After months of losses, the retailer was forced to declare -------.
questions.explanation: Verbe + NOM complément : declare bankruptcy.

questions.prompt: It appears that the construction of the new terminal ------- completion.
questions.explanation: It appears/seems that + action en cours → présent continu : is nearing.

questions.prompt: The committee will review the process ------- new staff are selected.
questions.explanation: Préposition + WHICH (by which), jamais préposition + that.

questions.prompt: The new branch is ------- located near the central station.
questions.explanation: Adverbe + participe/adjectif : conveniently located.

questions.prompt: By the time the auditors arrive, we ------- all the reports.
questions.explanation: RAPPEL : by the time + présent → will have + participe passé.

questions.prompt: The company ------- its first store in Lyon in 2019.
questions.explanation: Date passée précise (in 2019) → prétérit : opened.

questions.prompt: Mr. Diallo ------- for the firm since 2021.
questions.explanation: since/for + jusqu'à maintenant → present perfect : has worked.

questions.prompt: The shipment arrived two days -------, so the client received a discount.
questions.explanation: Piège de sens : arrived two days late (en retard). « ago » s'emploie avec un moment : two days ago.

questions.prompt: We ------- the new software yet, but training starts next week.
questions.explanation: yet en phrase négative → present perfect : haven't installed.

questions.prompt: The CEO usually ------- the quarterly results in person.
questions.explanation: usually (habitude) → présent simple, 3e personne : presents.

questions.prompt: Last month, sales ------- by 12 percent compared with October.
questions.explanation: Last month (période terminée) → prétérit : rose. Et rise BY X %.

items.title: Samedi après-midi : -ing et tous les temps
items.theme: Règles prioritaires + temps (prétérit, present perfect, continu, futur antérieur)

questions.prompt: The manager avoided ------- any promises about the delivery date.
questions.explanation: avoid + -ING : avoided making.

questions.prompt: Several employees have suggested ------- a shuttle service to the new office.
questions.explanation: suggest + -ING : suggested offering.

questions.prompt: We strongly recommend ------- your password every three months.
questions.explanation: recommend + -ING : recommend changing.

questions.prompt: The supplier's ------- to deliver on time has impressed our buyers.
questions.explanation: Possessif ('s) + NOM : the supplier's ability.

questions.prompt: The marketing team is ------- a new campaign for the spring collection.
questions.explanation: be + -ING pour une action en cours (is preparing) : ici le sujet fait l'action.

questions.prompt: It seems that the two firms ------- the terms of the merger this week.
questions.explanation: It seems that + action en cours (this week) → présent continu : are negotiating.

questions.prompt: The office ------- the meeting was held has been renovated.
questions.explanation: Préposition + WHICH : the office in which… (= where).

questions.prompt: The board ------- a new chief financial officer last Tuesday.
questions.explanation: last Tuesday → prétérit : appointed.

questions.prompt: Ms. Rossi has already ------- the agenda to all participants.
questions.explanation: have/has + PARTICIPE PASSÉ : has already sent (already → present perfect).

questions.prompt: Our team ------- three new clients so far this quarter.
questions.explanation: so far / this quarter (période pas terminée) → present perfect : has signed.

questions.prompt: The factory ------- production two years ago because of low demand.
questions.explanation: two years ago → prétérit : stopped.

questions.prompt: The cafeteria ------- at 7:30 every weekday morning.
questions.explanation: every weekday morning (habitude, horaire) → présent simple : opens.

questions.prompt: Currently, the IT department ------- the company's servers.
questions.explanation: Currently / right now / at the moment → présent continu : is upgrading.

questions.prompt: When the client called, Mr. Ito ------- a presentation to the board.
questions.explanation: Action en cours interrompue dans le passé (when + prétérit) → past continuous : was giving.

questions.prompt: By next June, the company ------- in Marseille for ten years.
questions.explanation: By + date future + durée → futur antérieur : will have operated.

items.title: Dimanche matin : erreurs d'hier + voix passive
items.theme: Possessif + nom, présent simple / continu, voix passive vs active

questions.prompt: The manager praised her assistant's ------- in organizing the conference.
questions.explanation: Possessif ('s) + NOM. Repère les suffixes de nom : -ity, -ness, -ment, -tion, -ency.

questions.prompt: Thanks to the firm's ------- to innovation, sales doubled in two years.
questions.explanation: Possessif ('s) + NOM : the firm's commitment.

questions.prompt: The auditor recommended ------- the expense reports every month.
questions.explanation: recommend + -ING : recommended checking. Encore une réussite et la règle est maîtrisée.

questions.prompt: Ms. Park usually ------- her emails before the morning meeting.
questions.explanation: usually = habitude → présent simple, avec -s à la 3e personne : answers.

questions.prompt: Our technicians ------- the equipment every Friday afternoon.
questions.explanation: every Friday = habitude → présent simple (sujet pluriel, pas de -s) : inspect.

questions.prompt: At the moment, the sales team ------- a new pricing strategy.
questions.explanation: At the moment = action en cours → présent continu : is discussing.

questions.prompt: Please call back later; Mr. Okafor ------- with a client right now.
questions.explanation: right now = action en cours → présent continu : is meeting.

questions.prompt: The hotel has a conference room ------- up to 200 guests can be seated.
questions.explanation: RAPPEL : préposition + WHICH (in which).

questions.prompt: The committee will announce ------- of the design competition next week.
questions.explanation: RAPPEL : verbe + NOM complément (announce the winner).

questions.prompt: The new safety rules ------- by the board last Monday.
questions.explanation: PASSIF : les règles ne s'approuvent pas elles-mêmes → be + participe passé. last Monday → prétérit : were approved.

questions.prompt: All visitors ------- to wear a badge inside the building.
questions.explanation: PASSIF : les visiteurs SUBISSENT l'obligation → are required to + verbe. Expression très fréquente au TOEIC.

questions.prompt: The marketing director ------- the campaign results tomorrow.
questions.explanation: ACTIF : le directeur fait l'action, et il y a un complément (the campaign results) → will present. Un COD après le blanc = actif.

questions.prompt: The parcels ------- yet, so the customers are still waiting.
questions.explanation: PASSIF + present perfect : have/has been + participe passé → haven't been delivered (les colis ne livrent pas).

questions.prompt: Ms. Laurent ------- as head of the Lyon office last year.
questions.explanation: PASSIF : on l'a nommée → was appointed. appoint = nommer. Pas de COD après le blanc = souvent passif.

questions.prompt: The factory currently ------- by a team of 40 engineers.
questions.explanation: PASSIF au présent : « by a team » donne l'agent → is managed by. Le complément d'agent (by + personne) signale le passif.
